Bana diya hai — ek naya section **COD Confirmation Calls**, jo aapke asli Shopify orders par hi kaam karega (koi alag list nahi, taaki data kabhi mismatch na ho).

### Kaise kaam karega
- Board view, teen columns mein: **To call → Confirmed → Cancelled** (aapke apne status field se).
- Har card par order number, customer naam, phone (tap karke call kar sakte ho), total aur city dikhega.
- Har order ke saath ek **Call Notes** field hai (customer ne call pe kya bola) aur **Last Called** date, jo "Mark Confirmed" ya "Mark Cancelled" dabate hi aaj ki date khud bhar degi.
- Upar "Payment" filter se sirf COD orders dekh sakte ho (razorpay wale chhod ke), aur "Call Status" filter se pending/confirmed/cancelled.
- 3 stat cards: kitne COD orders abhi call ke liye pending hain, kitne confirm ho chuke, kitne call pe cancel hue.
- Ek saath kai orders select karke bhi "Mark Confirmed" ya "Mark Cancelled" ek click mein laga sakte ho.

Naye field (Call Status waala) abhi sab orders par khaali hain — jaise hi aap kisi order ko "To call" se "Confirmed/Cancelled" mark karoge, wahi se track hona shuru ho jayega.

Theek lagta hai to bata dijiye, approve kar dena.

Dono cheez ab design mein hain:

### Naya COD order
- Jaise hi koi naya COD order Shopify se aayega, yeh khud-ba-khud **To call** mein chala jayega — kisi ko haath lagana nahi padega. Test karke dekha: abhi ke 2 COD orders (#1006, #1008) is rule se To call set ho jaate.

### Shopify mein order cancel karna
- Shopify ka order status (status field) toh apne aap sync ho jaata hai — yeh already read-only copy hai, kuch alag se karna nahi padta.
- Lekin aapka call-tracking status (To call/Confirmed/Cancelled) ek alag field hai jo khud nahi badalta. Isliye ek rule bhi laga di: jab Shopify mein order **Cancelled** ho jaaye, yeh call status bhi khud Cancelled mark kar dega (aaj ki date ke saath) — taaki dono kabhi mismatch na ho.

transcript.text: jin orders mein delay hai un customers ko WhatsApp pe message bhej do

WhatsApp bhejna is platform se possible nahi hai — Warmluke email, SMS ya WhatsApp bhej nahi sakta (yeh "not reachable from here yet" list mein hai). Jo main kar sakta hoon: delayed orders ko khud pakad kar ek list bana doon aur jab bhi koi order delay ho jaaye, aapko bell mein alert bhej doon (customer name, phone, order number ke saath) — taaki aap one tap mein unhe WhatsApp/call kar sakein.

"Delay" ka matlab clear karna hoga:
- Unfulfilled order jo placed hone ke X din baad bhi fulfil nahi hua? ya
- Shipped order jo Shipped ke Y din baad bhi delivered nahi hua (abhi IN_TRANSIT)?

Filhaal data mein ek order (#1006) IN_TRANSIT/UNFULFILLED dikh raha hai purana. Bata dijiye konsi definition chahiye aur kitne din ke baad "delay" maana jaaye, main turant ek section + alert rule bana deta hoon jisme Phone bhi dikhega taaki aap seedha WhatsApp pe message bhej sakein.

transcript.text: jo customer pehle bhi order kar chuka hai aur ab COD pe order kiya hai, un orders ko mark kar do taaki main call kar saku

Maine ek naya section bana diya hai — **COD Repeat Orders** — jo Shopify ke orders par based hai, aur isme do fields add kiye hain jo aap khud bharenge: **Call needed** aur **Call status** (Not called / Called / No answer).

Ek rule bhi jod diya hai jo roz subah 9 baje chalega aur un orders ko flag karega jinka:
- **gateway "Cash on Delivery (COD)"** hai, aur
- **wahi phone number** kisi aur order mein bhi mila hai (yaani repeat customer)

Jab match milega, wo order "Call needed = Yes" ho jayega, "Call status = Not called" set hoga, aur aapko bell mein ek alert bhi milega (order number, customer, phone aur total ke saath) taaki aap call kar sakein.

Maine aapke current orders pe haath se check kiya — abhi inme se **#1002, #1003, #1005, #1006, #1009, #1011** is tarah flag hone chahiye (Meera, Zoya, Vikram, Arjun — sab repeat COD customers), jabki Ananya Bose (#1008) sirf ek hi order hai isliye flag nahi hoga.

Ek baat clear kar du: ye sirf app ke andar list/alert dega — khud call lagana, SMS ya WhatsApp bhejna abhi connected nahi hai, wo manually karna hoga.
